final_answer: The computational security status of the AES-256 encryption standard against brute-force attacks is that it is secure on current and foreseeable hardware. The computational complexity of brute-force attacks is extremely high, making it impractical. Additionally, AES-256 is considered quantum resistant. (Sources: Retrieved Document 2, 3, and 5)
